ios.desc:
Scan a business card and get the whole contact in one tap — name, title, company, every phone number, email, website and address — saved straight to your iPhone Contacts.

Cardr reads cards entirely on your device using Apple Intelligence. No account. No subscription. No cloud. Your cards never leave your phone.

WHY CARDR
• One tap, the whole card — not field-by-field like the built-in camera.
• 100% on-device — powered by Apple's on-device model on iPhone 15 Pro and newer.
• Straight to Contacts — review, fix anything, then save. You always confirm before anything is saved.
• Private by design — no sign-up, no tracking, no servers. App Privacy label: Data Not Collected.
• Your history, on your phone — keep a local list of everything you've scanned.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Point your camera at a business card.
2. Cardr reads it instantly and lays the details out in clean fields.
3. Review, fix anything, and save to Contacts.

PRICING
Your first 3 scans are free. Unlock unlimited scans with a one-time purchase — no subscription, ever.

CARDR PRO
Want more? Cardr Pro adds batch scanning, CSV/vCard export, and search across your scan history — also a one-time purchase, no subscription.

REQUIREMENTS
Requires iPhone 15 Pro or newer with Apple Intelligence (iOS 26).

No account. No subscription. No cloud. Just scan and go.
